official_source_or_provider: Geoscience Australia / Digital Earth Australia STAC endpoint
source_status: Official route with redesigned query granularity
stability_evidence: Reduces full-window searches from 924 to 420, a 54.5% reduction, before retries; still blocked if STAC returns HTTP 503 globally.
data_volume: Ignored metadata cache per candidate-month; COG reads remain streamed
licensing_provenance: DEA Water Observations CC BY 4.0; cache manifest should record collection, month, bbox hash, item count, and source URL
scientific_equivalence: Likely equivalent if candidate bbox item sets are filtered down to support intersections without losing scenes.
stac_call_effect: Reduces live STAC searches and max attempts to 420 and 1260.
execution_environment: Mac mini for design and small tests; deep-server-ts for heavier extraction after gate
smoke_test: Build one candidate/month cache, then compare cached item coverage with per-support STAC when STAC is available
commit_policy: Commit code, settings, manifest, and compact item-count summaries only; keep cache JSON ignored
recommendation: Recommended as the nearest scientifically equivalent redesign once STAC availability returns.

official_source_or_provider: Geoscience Australia / Digital Earth Australia STAC endpoint
source_status: Official route with strongest STAC batching
stability_evidence: Reduces full-window searches from 924 to 84, a 90.9% reduction; still needs robust pagination and item filtering.
data_volume: Potentially larger ignored month-level metadata cache; COG reads remain streamed

scientific_equivalence: Equivalent only if union bbox and pagination capture every item intersecting every support.
stac_call_effect: Reduces live STAC searches and max attempts to 84 and 252.
execution_environment: Mac mini for cache prototype; deep-server-ts for extraction if prototype passes
smoke_test: Prototype one month over all current supports and verify per-support item coverage
commit_policy: Commit cache design and compact manifests; keep item caches ignored
recommendation: Recommended as Goal 012 stretch target after candidate-month cache proves coverage.

official_source_or_provider: Geoscience Australia / Digital Earth Australia public AWS S3 bucket and inventory
source_status: Official public data route; Goal 011 S3 prefix and COG HEAD probes succeeded
stability_evidence: Goal 011 listed a known ga_ls_wo_3 prefix and HEADed a known water COG with HTTP 200 while STAC returned 503.
data_volume: S3 inventory/index may be large and must remain ignored; per-scene COGs can be streamed without full download
licensing_provenance: DEA public data bucket; Water Observations product is CC BY 4.0; S3 route requires AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST for programmatic access
scientific_equivalence: Potentially equivalent only after path/row and month item discovery is proven complete against STAC/datacube metadata.
stac_call_effect: Can avoid live STAC search entirely for known indexed path/row/month keys.
execution_environment: Mac mini for S3/index prototype; deep-server-ts for larger path/row extraction
credentials_or_access: No credentials for public bucket; internet and no-sign S3 access required
smoke_test: Build one candidate/month path-row inventory and compare found water COGs to STAC after service recovery
commit_policy: Commit index recipe and compact manifests only; keep inventories, item JSON, and rasters ignored
recommendation: Recommended as an immediate parallel Goal 012 prototype because it worked during the STAC outage.

official_source_or_provider: Geoscience Australia / Digital Earth Australia Waterbodies
stability_evidence: Official docs provide waterbody polygons and per-waterbody wet-surface time series; known limitations for vegetated wetlands and narrow/patchy water.
data_volume: Small CSV time series for selected UIDs; shapefile already staged in ignored paths in prior goals
licensing_provenance: DEA Waterbodies CC BY 4.0; UID/version provenance required
scientific_equivalence: Not equivalent for whole Ramsar supports, vegetated wetlands, floodplains, or unresolved named subunits; useful for selected open-water UIDs.
stac_call_effect: Avoids live ga_ls_wo_3 STAC for selected DEA Waterbodies UIDs only.
smoke_test: Read one selected UID time series and compare dates with Water Observations scene cadence
commit_policy: Commit only compact derived summaries/manifests; keep source ZIP/CSVs ignored unless explicitly approved
recommendation: Use only as diagnostic/open-water fallback for selected UIDs, not as the primary hydrology route.
